launches.title: 🔊 Soundry AI - Generative AI for musicians
launches.tagline: We provide a music sample generator for music creators
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [Mark](https://www.linkedin.com/in/markbuckler/), [Justin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justinparus/), and [Diandre](https://www.linkedin.com/in/diandre-ruiz/) and we’re thrilled to introduce you to [Soundry AI](https://soundry.ai/): **a text-to-sound AI generator for musicians**. Our AI creates musical building blocks perfect for reducing friction in the music creation process.

# 

# 🦸‍♂️ The Team

All three co-founders are united in their love of music. After completing his PhD in AI at Cornell, Mark got his start in the music industry by founding the [Codex Collective](https://codexcollective.co/press-kit), a live music event production company in Seattle. Justin quickly joined, and all three founders met for the first time when Diandre came to Seattle to perform as [Bandlez](https://www.instagram.com/bandlez/), the music project he co-founded. Justin is an engineer extraordinaire, first cutting his teeth on large-scale data processing during his time at Microsoft Azure. Diandre is a professional musician who has performed all over the world and written music with big names, including [Shaquille O’Neal](https://open.spotify.com/track/2oCzWh04Rt4WBr7StVUCHe)!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78937&key=user_uploads/1320080/71009b68-f2c7-400e-afbc-466111c5784a)

# **🔇** The Problem

Music production technology has become increasingly democratized over the years, but creating a piece of music that you are proud of is just as challenging as it’s ever been. These days, most music is made by combining multiple audio recordings of individual instruments (called music samples) into a full song. Music sample libraries are easy to use which has led to massive growth for companies who provide them ([Splice,](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/splice) [Output,](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/output) etc), but they have a few key issues:

* Professional music producers are often prohibited from using sample libraries due to [copyright strike concerns](https://www.theverge.com/2020/2/17/21140838/justin-bieber-changes-running-over-asher-monroe-synergy-splice-sample-melody).
* Amateur music producers feel a lack of authenticity when using sounds made by someone else and struggle to make meaningful changes to them.

Generative AI offers a unique opportunity to build music creation tools that are easy to use and offer fine-grained artistic control. Unfortunately, existing AI music platforms ([Suno,](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/suno-279f) [Boomy](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/boomy), etc) offer very little customization and next to no ability to modify any generated output.

# **🎵** Our Solution

Our team at Soundry AI has led the charge by launching the first-ever text-to-sample generator. Our proprietary foundational latent diffusion transformer offers state-of-the-art audio quality due to the efforts of our research team and partnerships with leaders in electronic music production. As you can see in [the video below](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MT3k4VV5yrs&ab_channel=SoundryAI), musicians like Diandre can use our tool to create unique, high-quality, copyright-free samples perfect for their music projects.

This past week we released our newest product: [Infinite Sample Packs](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/fEfYkkon7YI). Now, all that a user needs to do is click a button to get accurate stylized sounds. Professionals have praised the quality and specificity of the sounds, and amateurs have been thrilled with the simplified interface.

# **📢** Call to Action

If making music is your thing, we’d love for you to try our sample generator [here!](https://soundry.ai/) We’d be so thankful if you to share our product with all of your musical friends, and if you have any questions then please reach out via [founders@soundry.ai.](mailto:founders@soundry.ai) We can’t wait to hear from you!

launches.title: ⚡️ CrowdVolt - StockX for live event tickets
launches.tagline: Exchange tickets to see your favorite DJs, electronic music shows and festivals!
launches.body:
**Tl;dr** [CrowdVolt](https://crowdvolt.com/) ⚡️ lets fans resell tickets to events, starting with raves & EDM concerts. We are a social, bid/ask style marketplace with counterparty security and favorable financing terms.

❌ **The problem**

The secondary ticketing marketplace is fundamentally broken. Fees have skyrocketed, while the user experience has deteriorated. As giants such as Ticketmaster and SeatGeek have moved towards lucrative primary sales in partnership with large venues, they have disenfranchised a whole class of live event attendees.

Many have naturally aggregated themselves on grey markets on legacy social media platforms (think Facebook marketplace and Reddit) to avoid institutional barriers and attempt to find better pricing/execution. These social platforms are not designed to house this type of exchange.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/aaead000-ef6c-4e10-ac85-0cc03a7a3b9c)

🔥  **Our solution – the StockX of tickets** (StockX uses a bid/ask style model for collectible sneakers and streetwear)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/8ae6c463-3456-4f1c-83c5-4c63c4626f4d)

* A two-sided marketplace for tickets: buyers can opt to “buy now” or bid, while sellers can opt to “sell now” or ask for a higher price, all with a publicly viewable transaction book
* Counterparty security: CrowdVolt intermediates transactions with secure payment processing, avoiding fraudulent activity and scams; third-party issued tickets are automatically transferred between counterparties
* Social: gone are the days of buying or selling from an anonymous blue dot on Ticketmaster; concerts are communal events meant to be experienced with others, so we’ve made buying and selling a social experience with social media integration and messaging
* Financing: sellers do not wait until event occurrence to receive payouts, but rather receive payment within days, alleviating the cash flow burden

Check out our promo [here](https://youtu.be/WszI6Jfi650)!

**🌃 Background**

[Josh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/josh-karol-4b1a97143/) and [Max](https://linkedin.com/in/max-hammer-2360571b2) grew up down the street from each other, while [Aria](https://linkedin.com/in/ariamohseni) and Josh met in college. We have diverse professional backgrounds across tech, finance, and consulting, but a common love for EDM (Aria is also a DJ, having played at iconic New York venues including the Williamsburg Hotel and Virgo Night Club in front of crowds numbering 2k+). We are avid attendees of this genre of events (80+ in 2023), and know the secondary marketplace experience through the existing mediums is poor, so have opted to rebuild it ourselves.

_A few years ago…_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/adf1e869-6351-48ec-b912-d88b7b01efa3)

_Now!_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/a49dd802-e56f-44fa-8d9c-64d0af809737)

**Our ask 🙏**

We’ve started in our hometown, New York, with our favorite genre of music, and will look to expand to other geographies and primary point of sale in the future.

* If you know anyone working in the live events space – ranging from artists to event managers to promoters – let us know! We’d love to connect.
* If you’re a fan of dance music, festivals, or raves (or have friends who are!) – hit us up at [founders@crowdvolt.com](mailto:founders@crowdvolt.com)!
* Sign up now at [https://www.crowdvolt.com](https://www.crowdvolt.com/) if you’re in New York, or join the waitlist for your city at <https://www.crowdvolt.com/waitlist>!

name: Mixy
long_description:
Live out your DJ dreams with Mixy, the mind-blowing music app that lets you mash-up any song in seconds.

⁕ Add your songs
⁕ Instantly blend vocals and beats
⁕ Play and share your mashup anywhere

There’s no limit to your imagination!

⁕ Launched to #1 in Music on June 19th
⁕ 1.5M users in 3 months
⁕ 15M mashups made and growing
one_liner: Make mashups without knowing how to DJ

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Jonah and Joe first met as teen tech YouTubers in 2008 and began building iPhone apps together in 2009. At the end of 2024, we started Mixy as a fun way for fans to make mashups of their favorite songs.

We publicly iterated prototypes on TikTok, which led to over 350k pre-orders before launch. Mixy debuted on June 19th, hitting #1 in Music and reaching #3 overall in the App Store. Since then, more than 1.5M users have created and shared over 15M mashups.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Derivative musical works are being created at an exponential rate, but artists aren’t getting credited, and billions of dollars are being left on the table.

Every year, millions of songs are uploaded to music platforms with uncredited samples. Generative AI has accelerated this problem: music is being trained on artists’ work and re-uploaded without attribution, ownership, or financial stake for the creators who made it possible.

Mixy flips this model. We celebrate artists by letting fans directly manipulate and share versions of their songs. Every time a fan shares their creation, the artist is automatically credited and their work is distributed more widely. Because Mixy owns the creation layer, attribution is native. We auto-credit every source track and pair it with a music-first social network built for playback and discovery.

The future isn’t millions of disconnected AI songs or samples, it’s millions of recognizable songs evolving through thousands of shared versions.

We’re tackling this because we love music, see a timely problem, and bring a world-class background in creative tools and consumer social.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
If we truly succeed, Mixy will be the platform that redefines music in the age of derivative works. What TikTok is to YouTube, Mixy is to music.

We’ll be the first to establish proper licensing and attribution standards for a future where songs constantly evolve into new versions. Every derivative creation, whether a mashup, remix, AI-generated variation, or fan edit, will flow back to the original artist with automatic credit and revenue.

Music expression and consumption will no longer be limited to static recordings. Instead, the world will experience songs as living, evolving works. Fans will become co-creators, artists will be celebrated more widely than ever, and the industry will unlock billions in new value.

In this future, music is not just listened to. It’s played with, passed around, and endlessly reinterpreted, with artists always at the center.

⁕ Instantly pay out artists and creators per second on plays

⁕ The music industry will unlock billions in value and Mixy will change how we experience music forever

**Our Story**

Joe and Jonah met as tech YouTubers in 2008, and began building apps together in 2009. They’ve worked at Apple, Instagram, and Skillshare. Recently Jonah led mobile at Tithly (Stripe’s 8th largest customers), and Joe founded a consumer social startup acquired by CoinList ($100M Series A), where he led product.

At the end of 2024, we started Mixy was started as a fun way for fans to make mashups of their favorite songs. Prototypes were shared on TikTok, which led to over 350k pre-orders before launch. Mixy debuted on June 19th, hitting #1 in Music and reaching #3 overall in the App Store. Since then, more than 1.5M users have created and shared over 18M mashups.

---

**Problem & Vision**

We believe Remixing is the new Shuffle.

Fans are searching for infinite ways to experience their favorite artists, and the tools to remix and create derivatives are far too complicated.

For artists, derivative musical works are being created at an exponential rate, but artists aren’t getting credited, and billions of dollars are being left on the table.

Mixy flips this model. We celebrate artists by letting fans directly manipulate and share versions of their songs. Every time a fan shares their creation, the artist is automatically credited and their work is distributed more widely. Because Mixy owns the creation layer, attribution is native. We auto-credit every source track and pair it with a music-first social network built for playback and discovery.

The future isn’t millions of irrelevant AI songs, it’s millions of recognizable songs evolving through thousands of shared versions.

If we truly succeed, Mixy will be the platform that redefines music in the age of derivative works. What TikTok is to YouTube, Mixy is to Spotify.

We’re tackling this because we love music, see a timely problem, and bring a world-class background in creative tools and consumer social.
